description: Defines the Http2PriorityDependencies class, which manages HTTP/2 stream priorities and dependencies, including stream creation, destruction, and priority updates, with internal data structures for efficient management.

classes.name: Http2PriorityDependencies
classes.description: A helper class for managing HTTP/2 stream priorities and dependencies.

methods.name: Http2PriorityDependencies
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the priority dependencies manager.

methods.name: OnStreamCreation
methods.description: Handles logic when a new stream is created, determining its parent, weight, and exclusivity.

methods.name: OnStreamDestruction
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a stream is destroyed.

methods.name: OnStreamUpdate
methods.description: Updates the priority of an existing stream and returns dependency updates.

methods.name: PriorityLowerBound
methods.description: Finds the lowest-priority stream with priority >= given priority.

methods.name: ParentOfStream
methods.description: Finds the parent stream of a given stream.

methods.name: ChildOfStream
methods.description: Finds the child stream of a given stream.
